opportunities.title: Small Research Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 10 March. You will be notified in late May regarding the outcome of your application. If you apply during round 1, projects should start from early June 2026 to early December 2026.

Applications open on 8 June and close on 8 September. You will be notified in late November regarding the outcome of your application. If you apply during round 2, projects should start from early December 2026 to early June 2027.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 8 June and close on 8 September.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership, be a PhD student or postgraduate researcher, and work or study at a university or research institution. Cannot be part of a funded fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Providing up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 30 April and close on 17 May. You will be notified by the end of May regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late May to late September.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 30 April and close on 17 May.

amount.raw: A maximum of £500 is available for events in person, and £250 for virtual conferences/courses.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a PhD student or postgraduate researcher, have BES membership, and work or study at a university or research institution. Cannot be part of a funded fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers to meet the costs of specialist field training courses, or the travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member, citizen of and based in a Global South country, and have applied to present at the Annual Meeting. Must be at least three years since last awarded a BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical Research and Development Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September. You will be notified by the end of September regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late September to late January the following year.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership, be involved in teaching ecology at any level, and not be part of a funded fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Improving the education of future generations of ecologists by providing up to £5k towards evidence-based learning.

opportunities.title: Synthesis Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 25 January. You will be notified by the end of January regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late January to late May.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 25 January.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership, form a diverse group of 8-15 individuals, and include members from a range of countries and regions.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by contributing £30k towards the formation of new two-year synthesis groups.

opportunities.title: Long-term Research Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 25 January. You will be notified by the end of January regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late January to late May.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 25 January.

amount.raw: £500 per year for a decade of data collection

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership, be involved in ecological research, and not be part of a funded fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Supporting the launch of new long-term studies by funding up to £500 per year for a decade of data collection.

opportunities.title: Connecting Ecologists with Other Disciplines Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 25 January. You will be notified by the end of January regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late January to late May.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 25 January.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership, be involved in ecological research, and not be part of a funded fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Promoting interdisciplinary skills by funding up to £20k towards placements in different disciplines and sectors.

opportunities.title: Outreach and Engagement Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September. You will be notified by the end of September regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late September to late January the following year.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership, be involved in ecological research, and not be part of a funded fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Providing funding of up to £2,000 for individuals, teams and organisations to engage public audiences with the excitement of ecological science.
